BEHIND THE PROJECT

The ideaWhat it doesWhere it stands

The idea

Bring drafting, media review and video assembly into a deliberate workflow, while keeping costs and publishing decisions under the creator’s control.

What it does

Channel-scoped media previews, scene candidates, explainable clip ranking, creator-written caption cards and approved local MP4 draft assembly. A Next.js interface connects to FastAPI, SQLite and FFmpeg.

Where it stands

V0.5 is a local development project. Automatic speech transcription, YouTube uploading and production-ready authentication are not implemented. Its source repository is currently private.
